# Was the Algonquin Dam on the Fox River hacked?

**Reported.** Illinois DNR calls it an “apparent cyberattack”, an attempt at unauthorized access that staff blocked, and says the dam kept running. It has given no technical detail, so the attack itself is not independently shown.

Incident: Algonquin Dam apparent cyberattack, Nov 16, 2026. Also reported as the Algonquin Dam hack and Fox River dam cyberattack. First published Nov 21, 2026; last updated Nov 21, 2026, 5:37 AM ET.

> **Not verified: initial investigation only.** Nothing on this page is absolutely confirmed. It is an early look based only on publicly available sources, and it should not be treated as verified fact. Even items labeled "Confirmed" only mean a public source reports them. Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by the Illinois Department of Natural Resources, CISA, any news outlet, government agency, company, or anyone else named.

This is the current answer, not a final verdict.

## At a glance

- Status: monitoring
- Size: Local. A small dam in McHenry County, Illinois. IDNR says staff blocked access and it kept operating. No effect on river levels or the public has been reported. Several state agencies and CISA are investigating.
- Who is affected: No one is reported affected. Residents near the Fox River need do nothing. IDNR says the dam stayed secure and fully operational.

| Value | What | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| Nov 16 | Date it was spotted | Announced Friday, Nov 20 |
| 4 | Agencies helping IDNR | Three state, plus CISA |

### Known so far

- Illinois DNR announced on Friday, Nov 20 that it is investigating an apparent cyberattack at the dam, with state police, IEMA, Illinois DoIT and CISA helping.
- IDNR says it has no indication the incident is connected to other recent cyber events or nationwide outages.
- The White House said on Nov 18 that it sees no indication of a cyberattack behind recent tech outages. It does not mention the dam.

### Not known yet

- Who did it, and how. No one has said.
- Whether any dam system was actually reached. IDNR says access was blocked.
- Whether it connects to the outages of recent weeks. IDNR says no indication.
- Whether investigators will publish findings.
